programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: Peter La Fleur owns a small gym.The club has a few friendly clients - among them the shy Gordon, Steve and Owen, who is constantly looking for true love - but it does not make any profits.One day, the man is visited by lawyer Kate Veatch, representing the bank.He declares that the indebted premises will be taken over by White Goodman's network of thriving clubs.The only salvation for the Le Fleur club seems to be the upcoming dodgeball competition, in which the main prize is $50,000.From the helpless members of his club, Peter forms a team whose enthusiasm far exceeds their skills.Goodman does not give up and puts his players on the field.

programme.title: Our Son
programme.desc: Nicky (Luke Evans) shares his life with Gabriel (Billy Porter), who has devoted himself to raising their son.The other father has been feeling disappointed for some time and finally files for divorce.

programme.title: The Yogurt Shop Murders
programme.desc: The creators of the series investigate the circumstances of the shocking crime that occurred on December 6, 1991 in the city of Austin in the US state of Texas.Four teenage girls, 17-year-old Elize Thomas and Jennifer Harbison, who worked there, as well as the other's 15-year-old sister, Sarah, and her 13-year-old friend Amy Ayers, were murdered at a local ice cream shop overnight.Some of them were raped, and to cover up the traces, the killer set the place on fire.Although over 50 people, including the serial killer, confessed to the crime, the actual perpetrator has still not been identified.Witnesses testified that they saw two strange men in the ice cream parlor at night.

programme.title: U.S. Against The World: Four Years With The Men National Soccer Team
programme.desc: The story of the US men's national soccer team on its way to the 2026 FIFA World Cup in North America. The film shows Christian Pulisic, Tyler Adams, Tim Weah and Weston McKennie personally and professionally.

programme.title: Amrum
programme.desc: Spring 1945. Twelve-year-old Nanning hunts seals and works hard in the fields to help his mother.He faces difficult decisions.

programme.title: Quitter la nuit
programme.desc: Belgium.Emergency line operator Anna (Veerle Baetens) receives a call from a woman who has apparently made a mistake.After a while, however, he realizes that she is pretending to talk to her sister in order to confuse the driver of the car she is sitting in.When the car is soon stopped by the police, the passenger, Aly (Selma Alaoui), accuses the driver, Dary (Guillaume Duhesme), of rape.Although the man denies it, he is arrested.The investigation begins.The following weeks pass, during which law enforcement agencies look for evidence, the injured party tries to both obtain justice and return to normal life, and the suspect hopes that the case will be closed.The incident also does not allow Anna to forget about it, as it revived traumatic memories.Delphine Girard's film, which was nominated for an Oscar, is a development of the artist's short production from 2018.

programme.title: Across the Universe
programme.desc: 1960s.Young Briton Jude (Jim Sturgess) goes to the United States in search of his father, whom he has never known before.The man is said to be a university lecturer.However, he turns out to be an ordinary worker.There, Jude meets a teenage American girl, Lucy (Evan Rachel Wood).They both fall in love with each other at first sight.Soon, Lucy's brother, Max (Joe Anderson), is drafted and goes to war in Vietnam.Meanwhile, Jude and Lucy, along with a group of friends and musicians, engage in anti-war activities.Their guides are: Dr. Robert (Bono) and Mr. Kite (Eddie Izzard).Together they fight for freedom of speech and civil rights.However, the tense situation is not favorable for lovers.Adversity tears them apart.They have to overcome many obstacles to be together again.The film's soundtrack included several songs by the legendary band The Beatles.The film was nominated for a Golden Globe (Best Musical) and an Oscar (Best Costume Design).

programme.title: The Grinch
programme.desc: The only companion of the lonely and malicious Grinch is the dog Max. The green creature only leaves the cave in search of food.Meanwhile, the residents of Whosiów are eagerly awaiting a special time of the year, Christmas.Wanting to keep the peace, the Grinch plans to spoil the grand celebrations and kidnap Santa Claus.At the same time, Cindy-Lou and her friends intend to capture a Lappish benefactor to thank him for helping the girl's busy mother.Two opposing intentions will face an inevitable confrontation.Another film adaptation of the adventures of a character created by a children's book writer, Dr.Seuss.Previously, Jim Carrey played the green creature in the 2000 film "The Grinch: No Christmas."In the Polish language version, the characters were voiced by, among others:Jarosław Boberek, Lila Wassermann, Ewa Prus and Karol Kwiatkowski.The carol was performed by Katarzyna Owczarz, Małgorzata Szymańska, Adam Krylik and Krzysztof Pietrzak.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: The ninja turtles defeated their eternal enemy Shredder and each of them found a different job.Michaelangelo makes money at children's parties as a mascot.Donatello works as a telephone operator, and Leonardo exercises his character in solitude.Only Raphael remained faithful to his old ideals and fights hooligans at night.Meanwhile, Master Splinter begins to see signs of impending danger.Immortal entrepreneur, Maximilian J. Winters decides to take control of New York, and later the entire world.To do this, he summons his four stone generals and tries to open the gate to another dimension.Only a team of Teenage Mutant Turtles can stop him.

programme.title: Our Son
programme.desc: Nicky (Luke Evans) shares his life with Gabriel (Billy Porter), who has devoted himself to raising their son.The other father has been feeling disappointed for some time and finally files for divorce.

programme.title: Hollywood On Set 23
programme.desc: The program takes viewers behind the scenes of film production.In each episode, the creators discuss three cinema hits.They show how spectacular effects, impressive sets and acting performances are created.

programme.title: The Front Runner
programme.desc: Senator Gary Hart (Hugh Jackman) is extremely popular, especially among younger voters.In 1988, he decided to run for the presidency of the United States for the second time.He is considered by many to be the favorite.However, unexpectedly, his extramarital relationship with Donna Rice (Sara Paxton) comes to light.The media is publicizing this case, and Hart's career is in question... The director and screenwriter of the film, Jason Reitman, was nominated for the Festival Award at the Toronto International Film Festival.

programme.title: Welcome to Marwen
programme.desc: Mark Hogancamp (Steve Carell) is an illustrator, known primarily for his World War II graphics.However, he hides quite an original preference.He is fascinated by women's shoes.At home, she has a large collection of high heels, sandals, flip-flops and many other shoes.His secret is revealed unexpectedly and causes great emotions.He is attacked by a group of neo-Nazis.The injuries are so severe that they result in loss of not only memory, but also the ability to speak and move.His artistic career is ruined.The man starts therapy, hoping to regain his former shape.However, he struggles with enormous trauma and mental problems.He finally manages to find a new passion.He constructs a village in the garden, which he names Marwen.Its inhabitants, the dolls, are modeled on real people from his life.It turns out that the mockup helps him deal with panic attacks.However, he still cannot forget his experiences.Meanwhile, a new neighbor, Nicol (Leslie Mann), moves in next door.The film is inspired by the true story of artist Mark Hogancamp.The town he built is located in Kingston.

programme.title: L'immensita
programme.desc: 1970s. The Borghetti family lives in Rome, is attached to tradition and seems very happy.However, this is only an appearance.Clara (Penélope Cruz) and Felice (Vincenzo Amato) no longer feel love for each other, in fact they don't remember why they decided to get married.The decision to break up, although it seems logical, is unfortunately not easy at all.Clara, repeatedly cheated on by her husband, feels a true bond only with her three children, whose presence provides her with an escape from her overwhelming loneliness.It is for them that she still pretends to be a perfect housewife and tries her best to protect the hearth.Deep down, however, she is not happy.Important cultural and social changes are taking place in the background, which causes the couple's eldest daughter, twelve-year-old Adriana (Luana Giuliani), to become bold and declare that she is a boy.This unexpected announcement leads to a situation in which family relations become even more strained.The film was shown at the Venice International Film Festival.Contains autobiographical threads.Director Emanuele Crialese confessed during the festival that he was inspired by his own childhood.

programme.title: Arrival
programme.desc: Spaceships land in twelve different places on Earth.No one knows why the aliens chose these locations.The American military is trying to solve the mystery.For this purpose, the soldiers build a camp next to one of the mysterious objects.A talented linguist, Dr. Louise Banks, is called there.Together with Colonel G.T.Weber and physicist Ian Donnelly tries to find out what the real intentions of aliens are and determine whether humanity is in danger from them.Soon, Louise is sent to a spaceship to talk to representatives of an alien civilization.He must unravel the rules of the newcomers' language.He realizes that time plays a key role in the mysterious message.

programme.title: Bring Her Back
programme.desc: After their father's death, the siblings, Andy and Piper, are placed in Laura's care.The boy begins to suspect that the woman is hiding some secrets.It soon comes to light that their guardian is planning a dark ritual.

programme.title: Nightmare Alley
programme.desc: Times of great crisis.Stanton Carlisle (Bradley Cooper) is an ambitious and charismatic conjurer, but recently he has been plagued by bad luck in his life.One day, a man struggling with his difficult past meets an unusual couple from a traveling circus.It turns out that they both have supernatural abilities.Zeena (Toni Collette) is a clairvoyant, while her alcohol-addicted husband Pete (David Strathairn) is a former telepath.Thanks to them, Carlisle learns the secrets of human nature and begins to learn to recognize things that cannot be seen at first glance.He is trained in the art of manipulation.This knowledge opens up new opportunities for Stanton.An ambitious spiritualist, pretending to be able to read minds, intends to profit from the naivety of New York's elites.Together with the devoted Molly (Rooney Mara), he puts his plan into action.It is becoming a favorite in salons.Under the influence of a mysterious and seductive psychiatrist, Dr. Lilith Ritter (Cate Blanchett), with whom he becomes involved in an affair, he decides to defraud the financial tycoon, Ezra Grindle (Richard Jenkins).He turns out to be a dangerous opponent.Dark cinema directed by the acclaimed Guillermo del Toro.Four Oscar nominations, including Best Picture.

programme.title: Battle After Another
programme.desc: Pat (Leonardo DiCaprio) hides under a changed name as Bob Ferguson with his daughter Willa in a town in the desert.No one knows that in the past, this inconspicuous man was the leader of a group of revolutionaries that committed numerous acts of sabotage: his accomplices freed refugees, robbed banks and blew up government buildings.Sixteen years after the attack on the prison, the leader of the elusive gang is tracked down by his old enemy, Colonel Steven Lockjaw (Sean Penn), who was obsessed with Bob's beloved, Willy's mother.When the girl is kidnapped, her desperate father asks her former mentor (Benicio Del Toro) for help.Together they set off to search for the hostage.

programme.title: Queen Of Bones
programme.desc: 1930s.Teenage twins Lillian (Julia Butters) and Samuel (Jacob Tremblay) live in rural Oregon.They are half-orphans because their mother died during childbirth.The father, religious fanatic Malcolm (Martin Freeman), treats his children harshly.Ida (Taylor Schilling), who may become the teenagers' stepmother in the future, also shows no sympathy for them.Meanwhile, one day, Lillian and Samuel find a book of pagan spells in their mother's trunk.They come to the conclusion that using them will help them free themselves from the influence of adults and gain power not only over their lives, but also their surroundings.

programme.title: Clerks 2
programme.desc: After Randal and Dante's store catches fire, the friends must find another job.They still cannot come to terms with the loss of the premises, but they have no money to rebuild it.They get a job in a fast food restaurant.Soon, Dante decides to leave with his fiancée to another state.Things get complicated when it turns out that the manager of the place is pregnant.Meanwhile, Dante's bachelor party is approaching.Randall plans to organize a party whose main attraction will be a stripper.However, an unfortunate mistake occurs and things get out of control.Sequel to Kevin Smith's debut film.

programme.title: Scared Shrekless
programme.desc: Halloween is coming.This year, Shrek's favorite holiday is going to be really scary.Instead of traditional fun, refreshments and tricks, the ogre challenges his friends.Together with Fiona, Donkey, Puss in Boots and other fairy tale characters, he plans to spend the night in Lord Farquaad's haunted castle.The atmosphere of horror is to be fueled by spine-chilling stories.The one who overcomes his fear will win the competition.Biscuits, Donkey, Puss in Boots and Shrek tell dark stories... In the Polish version, the characters are voiced by famous actors, including:Zbigniew Zamachowski (Shrek) and Jerzy Stuhr (Donkey).

programme.title: Spider-Man
programme.desc: Peter Parker (Tobey Maguire) is an ordinary young New Yorker.Shy, a bit clumsy, he has been secretly in love with the charming Mary Jane Watson (Kirsten Dunst) for a long time.While exploring the laboratory, he is bitten by a mutated, radioactive spider.Since then, his life changes - he becomes a superhero.He is strong, fit and enduring, and his eyesight is improving.In addition, there are extraordinary abilities - climbing walls, jumping from heights, weaving spider webs.When his beloved uncle, Ben Parker (Cliff Robertson), is murdered by a burglar, Peter decides to avenge him.Using his supernatural abilities, he begins to fight the world of evil.His main enemy soon becomes the dangerous Green Goblin (Willem Dafoe).Adaptation of a popular comic book.One of the biggest box office successes in cinema history.The film received two Oscar nominations.

programme.title: Spider-Man 2
programme.desc: Student Peter Parker as Spider-Man fights criminals threatening the inhabitants of New York.However, his private life is not going well.He's losing another job.Meanwhile, Mary Jane Watson, with whom he is in love, plans to marry someone else.Peter's relationship with his friend Harry Osborn, who cannot come to terms with his father's death, is also deteriorating.He blames Spider-Man for this tragedy.She wants to take revenge on him.To achieve his goal, he makes a deal with Doctor Otto Octavius.The scientist's actions quickly get out of control.He transforms into Doctor Octopus and kidnaps Mary Jane.Peter must transform into Spider-Man again to save not only the people of New York, but also his beloved.

credits.actor: Doc Ock/Dr. Otto Octavius - Alfred Molina

programme.title: Spider-Man 3
programme.desc: Peter Parker (Tobey Maguire) had to reconcile his feelings for Mary Jane Watson (Kirsten Dunst) with his duties as a superhero.Meanwhile, he has another difficult task ahead of him.Spider-Man merges with a symbiote from outer space that needs a large dose of adrenaline to survive.As a result of this fusion, Spider-Man's costume changes from red and blue to black.However, the character of the hero also changes.Now he is arrogant and conceited.Meanwhile, he faces his greatest enemies, Sandman (Thomas Haden Church) and Venom (Topher Grace).At the same time, he also has to face himself.A new woman also enters his life and will cause a lot of confusion in the superhero's relationship with Mary Jane (Kirsten Dunst).The third part of the adventures of Spider Man based on the comic book by Stan Lee and Steve Ditko.

programme.title: Wildcat
programme.desc: 1950s.A devout Catholic living in the American South, Flannery O'Connor (Maya Hawke), wins a writing competition.Soon he goes to New York to meet with a publisher, hoping to interest him in his novel "The Wisdom of Blood".However, they do not reach an agreement.Flannery is also dating her mentor, Robert Lowell (Philip Ettinger), with whom she has feelings.After returning home, the woman notices disturbing symptoms of illness.It turns out it was lupus, from which her father died.Flannery becomes disabled, but he can count on the care of his mother, Regina (Laura Linney), although their relationship can be strained.All the time, the young woman is struggling with an internal problem, she is afraid that her writing is contrary to her faith.Only the wise advice of Father Flynn (Liam Neeson) makes her focus on writing.This is also influenced by the information about Robert's wedding to another woman.A moving, brilliantly realized picture, inspired by the biography of the famous American short story writer and novelist.Four-time Oscar nominee Ethan Hawke was behind the camera.

programme.title: What Happens Later
programme.desc: The inveterate dreamer Willa (Meg Ryan) and the pessimist Bill (David Duchovny), who once had feelings for each other, meet by chance at the airport after many years.Their plans are thwarted by a massive snowstorm, which forces them to wait for the canceled flights to resume.They haven't seen each other for over two decades.She is a masseuse practicing spiritual rituals, he is a down-to-earth corporate employee.They didn't part peacefully, so even though a lot of time has passed, they have a lot of explaining to do.They start talking not only about their current lives, but also about their painful past.Willa is lonely, although she always wanted a family.Bill has a wife and a daughter, but not everything is perfect between them.Former lovers discuss why they went their separate ways.They wonder what would have happened if it hadn't happened.They have the opportunity to finally say to each other what has not been said out loud before.It turns out that they are still not indifferent to each other.Based on the play by Steven Dietz.

programme.title: Towards the sun
programme.desc: The year 2057. People are increasingly concerned about what is happening to the Sun.It seems to be losing power, and the Earth dependent on it is gradually becoming covered with ice.Scientists are sending an expedition towards the Sun whose task is to place a powerful nuclear charge on its surface.Experts predict that such an explosion will stimulate the star's activity and thus save the world from destruction.After some time, however, it turns out that a similar mission had already taken place seven years earlier, but then none of the crew managed to return to Earth.This time, eight people are sent into space, commanded by the experienced Captain Kaneda.The Icarus II board includes, among others:Cassie, Capa, Corazon and Mace.It quickly turns out that someone is making every effort to prevent the expedition members from reaching their goal.Soon, one of the pilots makes a fatal mistake and deprives the crew of oxygen supplies.In addition, unexpectedly, the ship begins to receive warning signals from its predecessor.The situation is becoming more and more dramatic.

programme.title: Nightbitch
programme.desc: A woman (Amy Adams) gives up her career as an artist to become a mother.She is raising a two-year-old.Sentenced to isolation and everyday monotony, she becomes convinced that she is transforming into a dog.Initially, it displaces these symptoms as a side effect of stress and early symptoms of menopause.However, he notices physical changes such as patches of fur on his body, heightened senses, a growing tail, and the sudden appearance of six more nipples.She recalls her childhood in the Mennonite community, from which she escaped years later.In her surreal situation, she cannot count on her husband's support.Adaptation of the novel by Rachel Yoder.
